_meta.name: Embedding Classifier Data
_meta.description: Generate labeled (text, category) examples to train a compact embedding classifier/router with embedding_sft — no messages/SFT transform.

columns.name: text
columns.system_prompt: You generate a single short, realistic message that a real user would send in the [DOMAIN] setting. Vary phrasing, length, and vocabulary across generations so the dataset is diverse. Output ONLY the message text — no labels, quotes, or preamble.
columns.prompt:
Write one realistic user message that clearly and unambiguously belongs to the category: {{ category }}.

It must be classifiable as {{ category }} from the text alone, without mentioning the category name.
